Log In Try the Demo
Pacer AI Demo

Add the Claude connector

to see how you’re pacing toward revenue goals: by market, by product, by rep — the gap to close, and how to close the gap now.

Add Pacer AI - Demo in Claude 8 steps · 2 min

Enter your work email in the card above first: your access password appears there. Then follow these steps on claude.ai or in the Claude desktop app.

  1. 1

    Open Claude’s Add custom connector dialog

    Signed in to claude.ai in your browser? This button opens the dialog directly.

    Open the dialog in Claude
  2. 2

    Or open it from the + menu

    In the Claude app or on claude.ai, click + in the prompt box → Connectors → Add connector → Add custom connector.

    Or choose Manage connectors, then Add custom connector.

  3. 3

    Name it

    In Name, paste:

    Pacer AI - Demo

    Click the box to select it, then copy.

  4. 4

    Paste the server URL, then click Continue

    In MCP server URL, paste:

    https://pacerai-demo-mcp.azurewebsites.net/mcp

    Then click Continue.

Prefer to finish the setup on a call?

Schedule a Walkthrough →
  1. 5

    Keep the detected defaults and click Add

    Claude detects Sign in now and Register automatically. Leave both as they are and click Add.

  2. 6

    Connect and sign in

    Claude opens the Pacer AI sign-in page. Enter your work email and the access password shown in the card above once you enter your email, then click Start the demo.

    No sign-in page? Open Settings → Connectors → Pacer AI - Demo and click Connect.

  3. 7

    Allow the tools to run

    In Settings → Connectors → Pacer AI - Demo, open the Interactive tools menu under Tool permissions and choose Always allow. Claude then draws each chart without stopping to ask.

  4. 8

    Type pace

    Start a new chat and type pace. The month, quarter and year pacing charts render right in the chat.

Then ask a follow-up

gap
how do I close the gap to target?
Charts render right in the chat on Claude web and desktop. Follow up in plain English — ask about a segment, an account, or the month.

See it in action

A guided walkthrough: add the connector, sign in, type pace — charts render right in the chat. It runs on a synthetic recurring-revenue company.

Have a question about how it would work on your own revenue data?

Schedule a Walkthrough →
The demo runs on a synthetic recurring-revenue company with fictional accounts. Questions? will@getpacerai.com. Enter your work email above and your access password is revealed on this page — no call, no waiting.
